quote.message: Sinologists call this whitespace "Pangu's White", because it splits the chaos between full-width and half-width characters. Rumor has it that people who dislike putting spaces between Chinese and English have a hard time in love: seventy percent of them marry someone they don't love at 34, and the other thirty percent end up leaving their estate to their cats. After all, love and writing both need some white space.

text_autospace_description.message: Lets the browser render the gap between CJK characters and letters or digits itself. It is purely visual and inserts no whitespace, so copied text is unaffected. It applies to every site, ignoring the blocklist and allowlist.

text_autospace_tooltip.message: Lets the browser render the gap between CJK characters and letters or digits itself. It is purely visual and inserts no whitespace, so copied text is unaffected. It applies to every site, ignoring the blocklist and allowlist.

text_autospace_limitations.message: The downside: it skips symbols, and the gap is much narrower than a real space, so it works best alongside the God of Spacing.

text_autospace_not_supported.message: Your browser does not support this feature (CSS text-autospace).

ai_spacing_description.message: Some symbols (such as + or -) mean completely different things in different contexts, and the God of Spacing's static rules can only go so far in deciding whether to add a space. An LLM fills exactly that gap, so, ladies and gentlemen: God of Spacing AI has arrived!

ai_spacing_tooltip.message: Some symbols (such as + or -) mean completely different things in different contexts, and the God of Spacing's static rules can only go so far in deciding whether to add a space. An LLM fills exactly that gap, so, ladies and gentlemen: God of Spacing AI has arrived!

ai_spacing_description_2.message: It uses the browser's built-in Prompt API model. Everything runs on your computer (fully offline, no data is uploaded to the cloud), and more importantly it's free, so don't expect too much from the model.
